clips.text: Snow throws back 80 percent of the sun's burning light — how did bone save his sight?
He is a hunter on the spring ice — and his sunglasses are a strip of bone with a slit in it.
No glass. No lenses. And the slit makes him see SHARPER, not worse.
He walks all day across a burning white mirror — and his eyes stay safe.
The bone blocks the glare. The slit does the seeing.
How did bone save his sight?
The slit cuts the burning light to almost nothing — and sharpens his sight like a pinhole camera.
